channel.description: Recent content in Events on iBuildWith.ai | Domain Expertise + Building with AI is the New Baseline

item.title: An Overview of AI Dev Agents for Non-Developers
item.description: Get a deep-dive into AI development agents designed for professionals who work alongside development teams but don’t write code daily.

item.title: Building AI Skills Without Code: Designing Workflow-Driven Agents for Non-Developers
item.description: In this presentation, you’ll learn how to turn repeatable workflows into reusable AI skills, modular instruction sets that guide AI through multi-step tasks. Designed for product managers, content creators, and business professionals, you’ll learn a practical framework and see a simple AI skill built live from scratch.

item.title: Building Marketing Tools at the Speed of Vibes
item.description: Learn how to apply Vibe Coding techniques with platforms like Lovable to rapidly prototype and launch marketing apps.

item.title: From Vibe Coding to Shippable Solution + Vibe Coding Session
item.description: Learn how to go from a demo app to a shippable solution using structured documentation frameworks.

item.title: How to Publish your Vibe Coded App for Others To Use
item.description: Explore how to take your vibe-coded app from your laptop to the real world. You’ll learn the key steps for publishing with confidence—choosing the right hosting, and more.

item.title: Intro to Agent Skills at Cal Poly Pomona AI Fair & Hackathon
item.description: A practical session at the Cal Poly Pomona AI Fair & Hackathon 2026 introducing the emerging concept of agent skills, a simple, open format for giving AI agents new capabilities, domain expertise, and repeatable workflows.

item.title: Intro to Vibe Coding with Amazon Kiro Demo
item.description: Get a solid intro to vibe coding and how to structure your sessions for better AI-assisted results.

item.title: Multi-Agent Vibe Coding for Better Results
item.description: Learn the essentials of multi-agent vibe coding, what agents and subagents are, how parallel vs. serialized setups work, and why this approach delivers smarter, more reliable results.

item.title: OpenClaw 101: Practical AI, Smarter Workflows, and Secure Setup
item.description: Discover how OpenClaw helps knowledge workers and domain experts move beyond basic AI chat tools into smarter, more integrated workflows. This introductory session covers what OpenClaw is, how to install and configure it, and how to secure it properly using least-privilege best practices so you can get the benefits of practical AI without unnecessary risk.

item.title: Structured Vibe Coding Without Losing the Vibes
item.description: This session explores how vibe coding helps solo devs move quickly from idea to app while avoiding the common pitfalls of skipping structure.

item.title: Tech Showcase Lightning Demos - Cody Framework
item.description: 10 minute tech talks given by attendees. Marcelo will be presenting what Spec Driven Development is, how it works and demoing the Cody SDD Framework.

item.title: Turn Your Domain Expertise into a Mobile App with AI
item.description: Learn how domain experts and non-developers can turn their expertise into a mobile app using AI. This presentation and hands-on workshop introduces vibe coding through a real example, showing how intent and domain knowledge shape AI-powered apps.

item.title: Turning UX into Apps at the Speed of Vibes
item.description: Discover how AI-assisted vibe coding turns UX designs into functional apps at lightning speed using tools like Figma MCP, design systems, and Microsoft Copilot.

item.title: Unlocking the Strategic Mindset of AI + Quick Intro to Agent Skills
item.description: In this session, Sharad Aggarwal, Global Head of Strategy & AI Solutions at Google Cloud, breaks down how non-technical professionals can think strategically about AI, without needing to code.

item.title: Vibe Coding at Planet Cyber Sec Conference
item.description: Planet Cyber Sec Conference is putting on a 1 day AI event and I’ll be presenting on how to structure vibe coding to deliver a shippable, maintainable and scalable app.

item.title: Vibe Coding with Intent for Better and Faster Results
item.description: Learn how to express intent in your vibe coding through structured documentation frameworks.
